item.title: Whiskers 0.8.36
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.36

### Gemini Enhancement

  • Added an option to let Gemini handle transcription and enhancement together in a single request for faster results
  • Improved fallback behavior so Whiskers can return to the standard two-step flow automatically if the combined Gemini path fails

    • ### AI Provider Setup

  • Improved the AI provider settings with clearer model selection, smoother provider switching, and better status feedback while validation is in progress
  • Improved handling for saved API provider trust rules by refreshing managed security policies on launch

    • ### Licensing

  • Fixed license validation so Macs that need activation are handled more reliably during premium setup and refresh
  • Fixed certificate pinning for the licensing backend so license activation keeps working after backend certificate rotation
  • Kept license purchase actions visible when activation fails so recovery paths remain available
